title: The Weather of the family house on Kessler Street
author: Coral Nakamura
blurb: Mirabel Vasquez, a restaurant critic who has forgotten how food tastes, moves through the days like a tenant, not an owner. But when a stranger at the funeral knows the family by a name nobody uses, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must translate the untranslatable sentence and live with it, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
